shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\nFiles:\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.*'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\nTop-level project files:\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---' && cat next.config.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductList.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductList.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/Recommendations.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/Recommendations.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1460,1505p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && printf '\\nInstalled Next version: ' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && printf '\\nRelevant local docs/messages:\\n' && rg -n \"cacheComponents.*true|Partial Prerendering|Cache Components\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,140p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && printf '\\n--- next config lines ---\\n' && nl -ba next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- page lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts'
